hf_gate.notes: Dense hybrid Gated DeltaNet (GDN) VLM. 48 linear-attention + 16 full-attention layers (16x [3 linear + 1 full]). FP8 blockwise (128x128) e4m3. In-checkpoint MTP head (EAGLE 3/1/4). Vision tower 27 layers, hidden 1152 -> out 5120. Served via SGLang (lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38-27b, flashinfer 0.6.18) on DGX Spark port 30000.
